title: Account Management and Interval Usage Reporting by Beacon Ridge C&I Structure
content:
Service levels under Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts differ by structure in two respects: whether the customer has a named account manager, and how often the customer receives an interval usage report.

| Structure | Named account manager assigned | Interval usage report |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | no | quarterly |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | yes | monthly |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | yes | monthly |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | yes | monthly |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | yes | monthly |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | yes | monthly |

## Points of reading

- Real-Time Index is the only structure without a named account manager, and the only one that receives the interval usage report quarterly rather than monthly.
- Example (hypothetical): a facility on Fixed All-In Renewable has a named account manager and receives its interval usage report every month; a facility on Real-Time Index receives it once a quarter and has no named account manager.
